sources.entry: Bicimon - Bike Speedometer as Progressive Web App. (Demo) MIT Javascript

summary.one_liner: BiCiMon is a bike speedometer delivered as a Progressive Web App that reads your position to show your speed.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only describes the app at a high level. It says it is a bike speedometer and a Progressive Web App. It states it does no tracking beyond geolocation and stores no data. The README gives no details on the interface, supported browsers, or how speed is calculated. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under maps and GPS and gives the license as MIT and the language as JavaScript.
use_cases: measure cycling speed from phone GPS
install a speedometer app on a phone home screen
track ride speed without sharing data
how_to_run: Click logo to open (per README; no install steps given)
notable: PWA ready, can be installed like an app
caveats: README is very brief; no setup, browser, or platform details given
Relies on device geolocation to measure speed
